download_seeker_model: download a seeker model of a given type to the ParlAI model directory
download_seeker_model_with_version: download a seeker model with a specific version to the ParlAI data directory
check_seeker_model_built: check if a seeker model of a given type is already built in the model directory
download_seeker_model_tgz: download the model.tgz file for a seeker model type using the ParlAI download utility
get_seeker_model_dir: get the seeker model directory path under the ParlAI data path for a given datapath
